content: Jesus and Nicodemus
Pu hak Pharisee‐sinmuy amuṅaqw tāqa Nicodemus yan mātsiwhqa qatu, Jew‐sinmuy amuṅaqw moṅwi.

I’ hak míhikpuva Jesus aw pítuhqe, aw paṅqawu: Rabbi, itam hapi pas suyan uṅ God aṅqw sinmuy tutuqaynaniqe pítuhqat mātsi’yuṅwa; ispi kurs God qa úmumniqw, um k̇ātatayhpit hintsakqey kurs hin hintsakniq’ö.
Noqw Jesus lavayhtiqe put aw paṅqawu: Pas antsaa, pas antsa nu ūmi paṅqawni: Pas qa piw tihtiwhqa soon God moṅwtunatyayat aw yórikni.
Noqw Nicodemus put aw paṅqawu: Noqw hak wuynīk̇aṅw hin piw tihtiwmantani? Ya sen pam yuy ponoyat aqw pak̇e’, piw tihtiwmantani?
Noqw Jesus put aw paṅqawu: Pas antsaa, pas antsa nu ūmi paṅqawni: Hak kūyit‐nik̇aṅw pu piw Qahováriwtaqat Hikwsit qa akw tihtiwhqa pas soon God moṅwtunatyayat aw pákini.
Sinot ahpiy tihtiwhqa sinoniṅwu; pu Hikwsit ahpiy tihtiwhqa put ahpiy qatsit himuy’ta.
Pas uma soon qa pu’ piw tihtiwyaniqat nu ūmi paṅqawhqat um ep qa pas hin wūwantani.

Hūk̇aṅw haqami hūhuknik paṅsoq hūhukṅwu, noqw as um söykitaqw navotṅwu; nīk̇aṅw háqaqwnik̇aṅw pu haqaminihqat um qa mātsi’taṅwu; noqw pan hapi Qahováriwtaqa Hikwsi put ahpiy tihtiwyaqamuy unaṅwayamuy ep tumalay’taṅwu.
Noqw Nicodemus lavayhtiqe put aw paṅqawu: Noqw īi hin pasiwtani?
Noqw Jesus lavayhtiqe put aw paṅqawu: Ya um as Israel‐sinmuy tutuqaynaqanik̇aṅw īit qa navoti’ta?
Pas antsaa, pas antsa nu ūmi paṅqawni: Itam hihta navoti’yuṅqey yuaatota, pu hihta aw yórikyaqey tuawi’yuṅwa, noqw uma itahtuawiy qa ömahtota.
Noqw kurs nu pay yep qatsit ep hihta hinyuṅqat umuy āwintaqw uma qa tūtuptsiwe’, puyaw tis nu ōveqatsit ep hihta hinyuṅqat umuy āawnaqw uma hin put tūtuptsiwani?
Qa hak hapi hisat ōmiqatsit aw wūvi, pas ōveqatsit aṅqw hawhqa‐saa, i’ Sinot Tiat ōveqatsit ep qátuhqa.
Noqw ura Moses qayēsiwhpuve tsūat himutsokit ep hāyaqw, pan hapi Nu Sinot Tiat pas soon hihta ep qa hāyiwni.
Noqw nāp hak inumi tuptsiwhqa qa hovalniwht qatsit qaso’taqat makiwni.
Pi God sinmuy amumi pas unaṅway’k̇aṅw k̇ahk̇awnaqe, ōviy pas sūkw tiy tavi, nāp hak put aw tuptsiwhqa qa hovalniwht, qatsit qaso’taqat himuy’vani.
Pi God Tiy sinmuy ayo óyaniqat ōviy put aṅqw tavi, sinmuy hin yukunaniqat qa paniq’ö.
Pi God put Tiyat aw tūtuptsiwaqamuy amuṅem qa hinwat yukut, pumuy mātavi; nīk̇aṅw pam put qa aw tūtuptsiwaqamuy sivintoyniwyaniqat pay pan amuṅem yuku, puma put sūkw Tiyat qa aw tūtuptsiwhq ōviy’o.
Pay i’ Tāla tūwaqatsit aw pituqw, sinom put qa nānawaknat, soq qatālat ep hahlayya, puma qalomáhintsatsk̇aqe ōviy’o. Noqw paniqw hapi ōviy God pumuy sivintoynaniqey amuṅem yuku.
Pi haqam qalomáhintsakqa tālat qa hahlayṅwu, piw tālat qa awniṅwu, taq nāphisat k̇a hintsakpiat suhputsniwniqw ōviy’o.
Noqw pi i’ hak pas qaatsat hinmaqa tālat awniṅwu; nihqe pam God öqalayat ahpiy tumaltaqey tunvotnaṅwu.
Jesus and John
Iit atsve pu’ Jesus put aw nánatuwnayaqamuy amumum Judea‐tutskwat ep pitu; nihqe pep pumuy amumum qátuhqe, sinmuy kūyit akw tuvoylalawu.
Noqw Salem ahayhp Aenon ep a’nö pāhuniqw, ōviy John pep piw sinmuy kūyit akw tuvoylalawu,
Pam nāt sivikimi qa tūviwhqe ōviy’o.
Noqw John aw nánatuwnayaqam hakiy hin kwaṅw’ewayhtiniqat ep Jew‐sinmuy amumum nāṅwuy’yuṅwa.
Noqw puma John aw ö́kihqe, aw paṅqaqwa: Rabbi, ura i’ Jordan yupqöyve úmumnihqa sinmuy kūyit akw tuvoylalawu; noqw sinom sohsoyam put aw ökiwta. Ura um put hakiy lalvaya.
Noqw John lavayhtiqe paṅqawu: Kurs hak öqalat makiwhqa kurs hin qa ōṅaqw put makiwni.
Pi uma nāp inumi navoti’yuṅqw ura nu paṅqawu: Nu’ qa Christ, pay ura nu put apyeve ayatiwa.
Kwusi’taqa hapi möönaṅwniṅwu; nopw put kwātsiat wunuk̇aṅw aw tūqayte’, put tönayat ep pas hinhaqam hahlayhtiṅwu. Noqw ōviy hapi ihahlayhpi pas hin hintaniqey anhti.
Pam soon qa suyhtsepṅwat öqawi’mani; noqw nu pay soon qa pevewmani.
He who Comes from Heaven
Pi ōṅaqw pítuhqa hapi pas sohsokmuy amupyevee, noqw i’ tūwaqatsit aṅqwnihqa yep qatsit tunatyawta, nihqe yep qatsit tunatyayat yuaataṅwu. Oṅaqw pítuhqa hapi pas sohsokmuy amupyevee.
Nihqe pam hihta aw yórikk̇aṅw, pu navotqey put yuaata; noqw qa hak put tuawiyat kwusu.
Tuawiyat kwúsuhqa put hapi akw God pas antsanihqat paṅqawu.
Pi God aṅqw ayatiwhqa God lavayiyat yuaata; pi God put pas qa tuwanit Hikwsit maki’taq’ö.
Pi Naat Tiy aw unaṅway’taqe, ōviy sohsok hihta aw put öqalmaqa.
God Tiyat aw tuptsiwhqa hapi pay qatsit qaso’taqat himuy’ta; pu God Tiyat aw qa tuptsiwhqa hapi pas soon qatsit aw yórikni; pánis‐sa pi God itsívuat put aw huruiwta.
